_doc: AC05 (Блок-модуль пенного пожаротушения) VPM texture sets, the AC08 pilot-v010 recipe (PR #574 @ed743ab). Authority: presentation slide 35 + the binding legend [D171]; Gate 1 (#562, Artem «Принимаю»): roof RAL 7004, doors/gate RAL 7004, drop below ±0.000 = wall colour. ID1 = frame + roof + perimeter drop: roof plane grey 7004, the rest blue 5015 plain. ID2 = the inset sandwich field of each facade: ribbed 5015 with the slide's rib count on 1-2 / 2-1 / Б-А; on А-Б the field sits behind the grey gate (ID4) and only thin strips show -> plain blue as the slide's frame. Artem's texture gives colour, noise and one 8 mm joint; the repeat P = field / ribs. Faces longer than the tile are cut by edge rings at joints. Placeholders 256 px single colour. Address Bmpp_1 is a placeholder token.

2.why: sandwich panel field RAL 5015, vertical joints only, rib count per facade from slide 35; -y (А-Б) field strips around the gate plain blue

3.why: door / gate frame and hardware RAL 7004 (Gate 1)

PanelVJ45_RAL5015.why: long facades 1-2 (+x) / 2-1 (-x): slide 35 draws 44 joint lines at ~199 mm over the 8.96 m panel field -> 45 ribs evenly over the model field 8.9243 m (P 0.19832 m)
PanelVJ45_RAL5015.outline_why: thin dark outline of the panel field as on slide 35 (inner edge of the blue frame band): left/right = half joints at k = 0 / ribs, bottom/top = world z of the ID2 field (max-dump-005); not a horizontal joint
PanelVJ45_RAL5015.joint_why: TEC26 rule (orchestrator 2026-10-22, from the AC07 review): joints read as on the slide - dark, crisp lines; joint/panel luminance contrast in the compare image >= the slide's. Artem's joint colour (median (12,40,63)) at 8 mm gave 0.60/0.56 (VPM/NPM) vs slide 0.78 on build-v001; joint painted dark RAL 5015 shade (2,22,46), 10 mm wide (build-v002 with (6,18,30) lost its blue hue: the render joint counter treats non-blue pixels as no panel and split every joint in two); NPM joint 24 mm (npm_joint_half_mm 12): at the 2048 atlas (~97 px/m) the 16 mm joint gave contrast 0.69 vs slide 0.78 on build-v003

facades_doc: Rib contract from presentation slide 35 (the authority [D171]), counted on the slide pixels by compare_facades.slide_count: 1-2 and 2-1 44 joint lines (~199 mm, field 8.96 m; the DWG modules 278551 / 27A88C give 44 x 200 mm = 8.8 m with 43 interior lines - the slide/model field is 8.92 m with an uneven last strip), Б-А 13 lines (row at half height, skipping the end wall's inner frame line on each side). Even layout: ribs = joints + 1 over the model field (ID2 of max-dump-005: long 8.924311 m, end 2.23819 m). Facade names: +x = 1-2, -x = 2-1 (door, ID3 3.1 m2 on -x), +y = Б-А, -y = А-Б (gate ID4).

legend_doc: Binding legend (Artem 2026-10-22): every finish in exactly one row; RAL in the name = row RAL = KPP colour; ribbed rows carry the sandwich joint texture, plain rows none. AC05 has no RAL 7047 sandwich and no RAL 9016 glazing (slide 35: blue field and frame, grey door and gate only); no plinth is drawn (body blue down to ±0.000). Checked by finish_map.validate_legend before any texture, build or render.
